Reservations and Declarations for Treaty No.999 - Council of Europe Convention on Example Data Cooperation

Reservation contained in the instrument of ratification deposited on 12 March 2091 - Or. Engl.

In accordance with Article 18 of the Convention, Exampland reserves the right not to apply Article 7, paragraph 2, in respect of data held by its regional authorities.

Period covered: 01/09/2091 -

Articles concerned: 7

Declaration contained in the instrument of ratification deposited on 12 March 2091 - Or. Engl.

In accordance with Article 11 of the Convention, Exampland designates the Example Data Office as its central authority. Contact: Example Data Office, 1 Example Square, Exampletown. Tel. +99 123 456 789, e-mail: central.authority@example.org

Period covered: 01/09/2091 -

Articles concerned: 11

Objection contained in a Note verbale from the Permanent Representation of the Northwind Republic, dated 2 April 2092, registered at the Secretariat General on 3 April 2092 - Or. Engl.

The Northwind Republic objects to the reservation made by Exampland in respect of Article 7, paragraph 2. This objection does not preclude the entry into force of the Convention between the Northwind Republic and Exampland.

Period covered: 03/04/2092 -

Articles concerned: 7
